name: bizplug-automotive
description: The automotive & dealerships plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: book service and test drives. It works from the business's own published profile, covering service, inventory, hours and appointment requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
